children: On the heels of an expanded U.S. agreement with Uber Eats, Costco Wholesale is extending its partnership with Uber rival DoorDash to the U.S.
Costco's warehouse club members can now place orders from all of the Issaquah, Wash., company's U.S. locations through the DoorDash Marketplace, the companies said Thursday.
San Francisco-based DoorDash said it is now partners with eight of the 10 largest food retailers in North America.
DoorDash and Costco were already working together in Australia, New Zealand, Sweden, Iceland and Puerto Rico.
Costco on Wednesday unveiled a deal with Uber Technologies to offer deliveries via the Uber Eats platform in 47 states, up from 17 previously.
